projects.name: HWS (Hong Kong Workflow System)
details: Manual processing of Fixed Deposit instructions led to delays, errors, and reduced efficiency for branch and
operations teams. To overcome this, HWS was developed as a centralized application for staff to create, validate,
and manage Fixed Deposits online. The system supported FD creation with deposit amount entry, tenure selection,
rate assignment, and debit account verification. Automated validations, real-time status updates, and exception
alerts were introduced to reduce errors and improve accuracy. User-friendly screens for new deposits, renewals, and
closures enhanced staff productivity. Seamless integration with core banking systems enabled faster and more
reliable transaction processing. Standardized workflows ensured consistency across teams and strengthened audit
readiness. Overall, the solution accelerated processing, minimized errors, boosted staff efficiency, and delivered a
smoother customer experience.
• Collaborated with operations teams to capture requirements for Fixed Deposit creation, renewals, and
closures.
• Defined functional specifications for input fields like deposit amount, tenure, rate, and debit account
validation.
• Designed intuitive user screens ensuring ease of use and improved staff productivity.
• Documented exception scenarios and real-time alerts to handle data errors and process deviations.
• Coordinated with technology teams to enable integration between HWS and core banking systems.
• Prepared workflow diagrams and wireframes to streamline FD processing steps.
• Facilitated UAT by drafting test cases, validating results, and ensuring readiness for production rollout.
• Supported post-implementation reviews to capture feedback and enhance system performance.

entry.text: Project Title: HWS (Hong Kong Workflow System)
Duration: February 2024 -2026

closures enhanced staff productivity. Seamless integration with core banking systems enabled faster and more
reliable transaction processing. Standardized workflows ensured consistency across teams and strengthened audit
readiness. Overall, the solution accelerated processing, minimized errors, boosted staff efficiency, and delivered a
smoother customer experience.
Roles & Responsibilities as a Business Analyst
• Collaborated with operations teams to capture requirements for Fixed Deposit creation, renewals, and
closures.
• Defined functional specifications for input fields like deposit amount, tenure, rate, and debit account
validation.
• Designed intuitive user screens ensuring ease of use and improved staff productivity.
• Documented exception scenarios and real-time alerts to handle data errors and process deviations.
• Coordinated with technology teams to enable integration between HWS and core banking systems.
• Prepared workflow diagrams and wireframes to streamline FD processing steps.
• Facilitated UAT by drafting test cases, validating results, and ensuring readiness for production rollout.
• Supported post-implementation reviews to capture feedback and enhance system performance.

projects.name: GWIS (Global Workflow Instruction System)
details: Manual processing of Fixed Deposit and investment instructions across regions led to delays, data entry errors, and
compliance risks. To resolve this, GWIS was implemented as a centralized workflow system to capture, validate, and
route customer instructions seamlessly. Standardized input screens were designed to ensure uniform data capture
of amount, tenure, rate, and debit account details across geographies. Automated validations reduced manual errors
and strengthened compliance with regulatory requirements. Approval workflows with multi-level authorization,
validations, and exception handling were documented and streamlined. MIS and dashboard reporting within GWIS
were introduced to track instruction status, turnaround time, and compliance. This improved visibility,
accountability, and operational efficiency across regions. Overall, the project reduced turnaround time by 40%,
improved accuracy, enhanced audit trails, and delivered a better customer experience.
• Elicited and documented business requirements for Fixed Deposit and investment instruction workflows.
• Designed standardized input screens ensuring uniform data capture across regions.
• Defined multi-level approval workflows, exception handling, and compliance checkpoints.
• Conducted process mapping and requirement traceability to align business rules with system design.
• Partnered with cross-regional stakeholders to harmonize processes and resolve operational gaps.
• Prepared functional specifications and wireframes to guide development and configuration.
• Validated MIS and dashboard reporting requirements for monitoring turnaround time and compliance.
• Supported implementation by coordinating UAT, reviewing test results, and ensuring readiness for go-live.

route customer instructions seamlessly. Standardized input screens were designed to ensure uniform data capture
of amount, tenure, rate, and debit account details across geographies. Automated validations reduced manual errors
and strengthened compliance with regulatory requirements. Approval workflows with multi-level authorization,
validations, and exception handling were documented and streamlined. MIS and dashboard reporting within GWIS
were introduced to track instruction status, turnaround time, and compliance. This improved visibility,
accountability, and operational efficiency across regions. Overall, the project reduced turnaround time by 40%,
improved accuracy, enhanced audit trails, and delivered a better customer experience.

• Elicited and documented business requirements for Fixed Deposit and investment instruction workflows.
• Designed standardized input screens ensuring uniform data capture across regions.
• Defined multi-level approval workflows, exception handling, and compliance checkpoints.
• Conducted process mapping and requirement traceability to align business rules with system design.
• Partnered with cross-regional stakeholders to harmonize processes and resolve operational gaps.
• Prepared functional specifications and wireframes to guide development and configuration.
• Validated MIS and dashboard reporting requirements for monitoring turnaround time and compliance.
• Supported implementation by coordinating UAT, reviewing test results, and ensuring readiness for go-live.

projects.name: MWS (My Work Space)
details: Manual tracking of customer transactions across  multiple legacy systems created inefficiencies, delays, and limited
visibility for commercial and global banking clients. To address this, MWS was implemented as a replacement web
application for the online banking system, providing  a unified platform to view and manage customer transactions.
The application enabled secure access for operations teams to check balances, payment status, and transaction history
in real time. It offered intuitive dashboards and search functionality to quickly retrieve customer data across regions.
Automated validations and exception alerts reduced manual errors and improved accuracy. Seamless integration with
core banking systems ensured faster, more reliable transaction updates. Standardized workflows improved
consistency across teams and enhanced audit readiness. Overall, MWS improved efficiency, strengthened data
accuracy, and delivered a better experience for both staff and customers.
• Gathered requirements from business and operations teams for replacing the legacy online banking system.
• Documented functional specifications for transaction search, filters, and customer account visibility.
• Designed dashboards and reporting features to enhance monitoring of commercial and global client activity.
• Collaborated with technical teams to ensure real-time integration with multiple core banking platforms.
• Defined exception handling rules and access controls to strengthen security and compliance.
• Created process flow diagrams to map transaction verification steps across customer segments.
• Supported SIT/UAT by drafting scenarios, validating outcomes, and logging issues for resolution.
• Coordinated post-go-live support to capture feedback and recommend system enhancements.
Non-IT work experience:
